s01.shot: Wide cinematic shot: grand Royal Sword Academy gates at dawn, giant stone archway with crossed-sword emblem, the small weak boy walking in among proud noble students in white uniforms who mock him, epic ironic atmosphere

s02.shot: Extreme close-up of the boy's amber eye snapping open in shock and curiosity, dramatic eye highlight, dark background, question energy

s03.shot: The boy seen from behind walking away into mist toward the giant looming silhouette of a sword academy, story-beginning mood

s04.shot: The boy standing in a narrow poor copper-market alley at sunset, old copper workshops and hanging pots around, humble poverty, hero establishing shot

s05.shot: Close-up of the boy's trembling hands holding an academy acceptance letter with a red wax seal, nervous hope, shallow depth of field, dark interior

s06.shot: The boy standing with bowed head behind an old gray-bearded swordsman in dark blue cloak who hands an acceptance letter to a stern academy official at a desk, favoritism atmosphere, office interior

s07.shot: Training arena aftermath: arrogant noble youth in ornate white-and-gold uniform raising a wooden sword in triumph, the boy sitting in the dust catching his breath while laughing students cheer around them, dust clouds, harsh daylight

s08.shot: Blurred laughing crowd of students in white uniforms, except ONE sharp focused quiet hooded figure watching intently from the shadows, fallen boy in gray robe in foreground, dramatic selective focus, arena dusk

s09.shot: Night graveyard of broken ancient swords under a full moon, a long black blade that drinks the light stuck in a stone glowing faintly with violet mist, the boy reaching his hand toward it in awe, fog, mystical awakening mood

s10.shot: The boy with glowing amber eyes gripping a black sword hilt, living liquid shadows coiling up his arm forming a shield and blade, power awakening explosion of violet-black energy at night, dynamic low angle

s11.shot: Single slash aftermath: a giant rock split into two flying halves, the boy in follow-through pose with a shadow blade trailing violet mist, debris and shockwave, night clearing

s12.shot: Academy courtyard in the morning: an official duel poster being nailed to a board by a herald, the arrogant noble youth in white-and-gold uniform watching smugly, crowd of students gathering, tension

s13.shot: Close-up: the boy's calm face turning slowly toward the camera, a faint confident smile beginning, wind in his messy black hair, sunset side-light

s14.shot: Confident smile close-up, the boy's hand resting on a black sword hilt at his side, violet shadow mist curling at his feet, sunset arena bokeh behind

s15.shot: Epic cliffhanger wide: two figures facing off in an arena at dusk, the boy's silhouette with a shadow-wreathed black sword against the noble youth with a gleaming rapier, to-be-continued energy
